summary: This is a reference model, not something an engineer can build against yet: its own project record says it provides a reference model and defines requirements for a set of implementation specifications still to be developed, and the foundation that wrote the base document lists those implementation standards as under development. The catalogue abstract is ambitious - a layer stack, a spatial range query format, a data ontology, a credentialing method for granting access, and a contracting language that can execute obligations automatically - and it is the one clause in that list that claims terms can be acted on rather than merely recorded. Board approval on 28 May 2025 is confirmed, but the catalogue title still reads approved draft standard, so say board-approved and give no publication date. The register its naming would need does not exist, and the project record says the foundation was still working out with the registration authority how to build it. The identifier method its originators say the system will use, did:swid, is not among the 267 methods listed in the web consortium's register. The text is behind a paywall, so every row here is marked reported rather than verified: none of it comes from the normative text.

sources.title: IEEE P2874 project authorization request record (modified), IEEE Standards Association
sources.quote: This standard defines requirements for a set of Implementation Specifications to be developed for the Spatial Web.

coverage.note: The Spatial Web standard is a modelling and transaction layer. Presentation, including any blend with a camera view of the room, is left entirely to the client.
The standard models entities, activities and their governance. Reading the user's own face and body as a live stream is a device runtime's job and is not part of it.
The standard describes a graph of entities and their relations, not a place description in which a walkable surface or an arrival point would travel.

The standard does publish executable meaning — a contracting language whose statements are meant to be read by machines and carried out — and it hangs that on decentralized identifiers, so the pieces of a permanent naming scheme are present. It stops short of the row: nothing in it operates a namespace for published units of world logic, versions them, or guarantees that a name keeps resolving to the same code.

sources.title: IEEE 2874-2025 catalogue entry, IEEE Standards Association
sources.quote: a human and machine-readable contracting language that enables the expression and automated execution of legal, financial, and physical activities

coverage.note: Governance in this standard is expressed as rules and permissions on activities, not as a review that stands between finished content and its audience, and there is no publishing service in it to hold one.
The standard places entities in domains. It declares no map of a place with a version and a lifecycle, and publishes no transform between two maps.
Its spatial range query asks what is inside a volume, which is discovery, not a service declaring the area it answers for.
